evidence: Scanning electron microscope (SEM) images reveal that the carbon aerogels are comprised of an interconnected network of solid carbon filaments. Energy dispersive x-ray analysis (EDAX) measurements from the middle of the cleaved AAO membrane yield 8 at. % W. Transmission electron microscope (TEM) images recorded from interior fragments of the carbon aerogel. The surface area of the carbon aerogels was measured by nitrogen adsorption using the Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) method. The W coating thickness was measured using ellipsometry.
